# Data samples: official-news

Every data type of `official-news` as a real record of the committed test data, every field explained from its data contract, the fields only other rows have and a checklist for the production query. The [index](README.md) lists every domain.

- [release-source](#release-source)
- [press-release](#press-release)

<a id="release-source"></a>

## Official press releases: release-source (PRESS)

One publisher of official news (a central bank, a regulator, a government): its latest releases newest first, each a link, and its terms. One row per official press releases, keyed by SOURCE_ID. Read by the **official-news** pack's connector `officialnews-store` (lake table `officialnews.release-source`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/release-source.jsonl`, 9 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/release-source.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `SOURCE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `RELEASES`, `LAST_PUBLISHED` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 9 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json

  "BY_CATEGORY": [
    {
      "CATEGORY": "Uncategorised",
      "COUNT": 12
    }
  ],
  "COUNTRY": "GBR",
  "FEED_URL": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/news",
  "INTERNAL_ONLY": true,
  "LAST_PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T12:00:00Z",
  "LAST_PULL": "ok",
  "LATEST": [
    {
      "CATEGORY": null,
      "PRESS_RELEASE": "PREL-BOE-26D3012260",
      "PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T12:00:00Z",
      "TITLE": "Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes",
      "URL": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026"
    },
    {
      "CATEGORY": null,
      "PRESS_RELEASE": "PREL-BOE-E8D32C5873",
      "PUBLISHED": "2026-11-04T14:51:45Z",
      "TITLE": "Summary of the RTGS CHAPS Industry Forum - 13 October 2026",
      "URL": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/minutes/2026/october/rtgs-chaps-industry-forum-13-october-2026"
    },
    "… 10 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "LICENCE": "Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for personal or internal non-commercial use; other re-use needs its permission",
  "NAME": "Bank of England",
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "Source: Bank of England.",
    "DATASET": "Bank of England: press releases",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": true,
    "LICENCE": "Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for personal or internal non-commercial use; other re-use needs its permission",
    "RETRIEVED_AT": "2026-11-06",
    "SOURCE": "Bank of England",
    "URL": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news"
  },
  "PUBLISHER_TYPE": "central bank",
  "RELEASES": 12,
  "SOURCE_ID": "PRESS-BOE",
  "TERMS_URL": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/legal",
  "WEBSITE": "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news",

```

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BY_CATEGORY` | array of objects | required | The kept releases counted by category (CATEGORY, COUNT), the largest first. | — | [1 objects] |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].CATEGORY` | string | required | The category, Uncategorised when the feed gives none. | — | `"Uncategorised"` |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].COUNT` | integer | required | How many kept releases have that category. | — | `12` |
| `COUNTRY` | string | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | seen: `CAN`, `USA`, `EMU`, `GBR` | `"GBR"` |
| `FEED_URL` | string | required | The address the feed reads (RSS, Atom, or the Federal Register's API). | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/news"` |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | seen: `false`, `true` | `true` |
| `LAST_PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When the newest kept release was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05T12:00:00Z"` |
| `LAST_PULL` | string | required | ok, or failed (the kept releases are shown) when the publisher's feed could not be read. | — | `"ok"` |
| `LATEST` | array of objects | required | The newest 25 releases, newest first: PUBLISHED, TITLE, URL, CATEGORY and PRESS_RELEASE. | — | [12 objects] |
| `LATEST[].PRESS_RELEASE` | string | required | The release's page in Drishti (PREL-...). | pattern `^PREL-`; links to `press-release` | `"PREL-BOE-26D3012260"` |
| `LATEST[].PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | required | When the release was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05T12:00:00Z"` |
| `LATEST[].TITLE` | string | required | The release's title. | — | `"Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy …` |
| `LATEST[].URL` | string | required | The release on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-an…` |
| `LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for …` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The publisher's name. | — | `"Bank of England"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the release is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: Bank of England."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | — | `"Bank of England: press releases"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | seen: `false`, `true` | `true` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher. | — | `"Bank of England"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The original on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news"` |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | string | required | What the publisher is. | one of `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` | `"central bank"` |
| `RELEASES` | integer | required | How many releases are kept (the last keep-days, at most keep-per-source). | seen: `12`, `10`, `5`, `8` | `12` |
| `SOURCE_ID` | string | required | PRESS- and the publisher's id in the feed's YAML (FED, ECB, BOC, BOE, SEC, OSFI, FEDREG, GAZETTE1, GAZETTE2). | pattern `^PRESS-` | `"PRESS-BOE"` |
| `TERMS_URL` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The publisher's terms page. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/legal"` |
| `WEBSITE` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The publisher's page of releases. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news"` |
| `WHY_INTERNAL` | string | optional (filled in 44% of rows) | Why the publisher's releases are internal only, in words; empty when they are not. | — | `"The Bank of England allows personal and internal non-comme…` |

Fields no record above has, found by reading all 9 rows, with how many rows fill them.

| Field | Type | Rows with it | Meaning | Example |

| `LATEST[].CATEGORY` | string | 2 of 9 | The publisher's category for it, where its feed gives one. | `"Enforcement Actions"` |

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SOURCE_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SOURCE_ID`, `NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `FEED_URL`, `LICENCE`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `RELEASES`, `LAST_PULL`, `LATEST`, `BY_CATEGORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `LAST_PUBLISHED`, `TERMS_URL`, `WEBSITE`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `SOURCE_ID` per snapshot.
- `SOURCE_ID` matches `^PRESS-`.
- `BY_CATEGORY[].COUNT` is at least 0.

## Press release: press-release (PREL)

One official press release: its title, publisher, date, summary and the link to the original. One row per press release, keyed by RELEASE_ID. Read by the **official-news** pack's connector `officialnews-store` (lake table `officialnews.press-release`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/press-release.jsonl`, 18 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/official-news/samples/press-release.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `RELEASE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `TITLE`, `PUBLISHED`, `DATE`, `URL`, `CATEGORY`, `RELEASE_SOURCE`, `PUBLISHER_NAME`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 18 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "CATEGORY": "Enforcement Actions",
  "COUNTRY": "USA",
  "DATE": "2026-11-05",
  "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.",
    "DATASET": "Federal Reserve Board: press releases",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,

  "PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T16:00:00Z",
  "PUBLISHER_NAME": "Federal Reserve Board",
  "PUBLISHER_TYPE": "central bank",
  "RELEASE_ID": "PREL-FED-0224349908",
  "RELEASE_SOURCE": "PRESS-FED",
  "SUMMARY": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, LLC, Nano Financial Holdings, Inc., and Nano Banc",
  "TITLE": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, LLC, Nano Financial Holdings, Inc., and Nano Banc",
  "URL": "https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enforcement20261105a.htm"
}
```

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CATEGORY` | string | optional (filled in 67% of rows) | The publisher's category (the Federal Register: the document type and agencies). | seen: `Enforcement Actions`, `Monetary Policy`, `Orders on Banking Applications`, `Banking and Consumer Regulatory Policy`, `Other Announcements` | `"Enforcement Actions"` |
| `COUNTRY` | string | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | seen: `USA`, `EMU` | `"USA"` |
| `DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The day it was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05"` |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the release is shown or republished. | seen: `Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.`, `Source: European Central Bank.` | `"Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board: press releases`, `European Central Bank: press releases` | `"Federal Reserve Board: press releases"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | seen: `Public domain (US government work); cite the Board as the source`, `ECB copyright: free use with the ECB cited as the source; inside a paid product, buyers told the information is free on ecb.europa.eu` | `"Public domain (US government work); cite the Board as the …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board`, `European Central Bank` | `"Federal Reserve Board"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The original on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/en…` |
| `PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When the release was published, in UTC. | — | `"2026-11-05T16:00:00Z"` |
| `PUBLISHER_NAME` | string | required | The publisher's name. | seen: `Federal Reserve Board`, `European Central Bank` | `"Federal Reserve Board"` |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | string | required | What the publisher is. | one of `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` | `"central bank"` |
| `RELEASE_ID` | string | required | PREL-, the publisher's id and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-1 of the release's address. | pattern `^PREL-` | `"PREL-FED-0224349908"` |
| `RELEASE_SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher's page (PRESS-<id>). | pattern `^PRESS-`; links to `release-source` | `"PRESS-FED"` |
| `SUMMARY` | string | optional (filled in 67% of rows) | The summary the publisher's feed gives, as plain text cut at 400 characters; empty when the feed gives none. | — | `"Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement…` |
| `TITLE` | string | required | The release's title as the publisher's feed gives it. | — | `"Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement…` |
| `URL` | string | required | The release on the publisher's site: open it for the full text. | — | `"https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/en…` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 18 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `RELEASE_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `RELEASE_ID`, `TITLE`, `URL`, `RELEASE_SOURCE`, `PUBLISHER_NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `DATE`, `PUBLISHED`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `RELEASE_ID` per snapshot.
- `RELEASE_ID` matches `^PREL-`.
